text: Eccleston Drive is a local road with two way traffic extending west from Sloane Avenue to a dead end. The speed limit for roads of similar nature in the vicinity is 40 km/h. I have heard from concerned residents about vehicles regularly exceeding the speed limit on Eccleston Drive and I am requesting that the speed limit be reduced from 50 km/h to 40 km/h, to bring it in line with its other local roads in North York.
North York Community Council: 1. Reduced the speed limit from 50 kilometres per hour to 40 kilometres per hour on Eccleston Drive, between Sloane Avenue and the west end of Eccleston Drive.
